decisions.reason: The organic vegan superfood drink mix draws on consumer food formulation and marketing capabilities far from the firm's established biomass and waste-to-energy knowledge, limiting its ability to learn from early results and improve the product.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions build directly on the firm's engineering and prototyping expertise, allowing it to interpret market feedback and refine the product line.
This flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant is tightly aligned with the firm's core waste-to-energy and engineering knowledge, giving strong absorptive capacity to improve it and a low drop probability.
Plastic waste-to-fuel technology similarly leverages the firm's existing chemical and engineering capabilities, enabling it to assimilate results and improve the product.
